_comment: Per-game exceptions to the default `amiberry --autoload game.lha`, keyed by archive name without .lha. 'mode': 'drive' runs the prepared drive instead (needs the Prepare step). 'hardware' sets fields on the game's entry in Amiberry's WHDLoad database (for example z3_ram, in MB).

RocketAttack_v1.0.note: The slave deletes a file in its own game folder, which fails on the read-only .lha mount (DOS error 214 on 'sound').

UpScope_v1.01_Arcadia.note: Black screen under --autoload; runs from a prepared drive.

SuperSillySkidmarks_v2.2_CD.note: Needs about 9 MB of expansion RAM; an A1200 has 8 MB, so WHDLoad stops with 'Can't allocate ExpMem'. The LowMem_CD variant needs no override.
